# Intersections of unions: members that are canonical unions are resolved,
# non-canonical ones wait for union flattening (done = false), and the
# resolve/flatten loop of Run finishes the job.
builder
prim i integer
prim d double
str s unrestricted
prim nul null
obj o1 a:i - n=O1
obj o2 b:s - n=O2
union u1 o1,nul n=U1
union u2 o2,nul,s n=U2
inter x u1,u2 n=X
union nc i,d n=NC
uunion nonc n=NonCanonical
members nonc nc,s
inter y nonc,s n=Y
arr ax x
cls top x:x,y:y,ax:ax n=Top
top Top top
finish
query canonical 6
resolve debug
print
flatten
print
resolve
print
flatten
print
gc
print

# Classes can't be intersected.
builder
prim i integer
cls c a:i n=C
cls e b:i n=E
inter x c,e n=X
cls top x:x n=Top
top Top top
finish
resolve
